meta.title: Grade AI — Nidaamka Falanqaynta Imtixaanka ee AI
meta.description: Soo geli natiijooyinka imtixaanka, hel falanqayn degdeg ah, oo AI weydii wax ku saabsan waxqabadka dugsigaaga.

home.title: Fahan natiijooyinka imtixaanka dugsigaaga daqiiqado gudahood, ma aha maalmo
home.subtitle: Soo geli xaashida Excel ee natiijooyinka, Grade AI wuu hubinayaa, xisaabinayaa tirakoob kasta, oo qori warbixin cad — Ingiriisi, Soomaali, ama Carabi.
home.featuresTitle: Wax kasta oo dugsi uga baahan yahay natiijooyinka imtixaanka

excel.title: Soo gelinta Excel
excel.description: Soo geli natiijooyinka .xlsx, .xls, ama .csv. Saf kasta waa la hubiyaa ka hor inta aan wax la kaydin — buundooyinka waligood si qarsoodi ah looma bedelo.

analysis.title: Falanqayn toos ah
analysis.description: Wadarta, celceliska, darajooyinka, heerka guusha — waxaa xisaabiya database-ka, ma aha AI oo qiyaasaysa.

aiReports.title: Warbixino uu qoro AI
aiReports.description: Soo koobid guud, talooyin, iyo fikrado laga soo saaray xogtaada la hubiyay, oo lagu soo dejin karo PDF.

assistant.title: Kaaliyaha AI
assistant.description: Weydii "waa kuwee 10-ka ardayda ugu sareeya?" ama "warbixin u samee Ahmed Ali" oo hel jawaab ku salaysan xogta dhabta ah ee dugsigaaga.

languages.title: Ingiriisi, Soomaali, Carabi
languages.description: Warbixin kasta iyo interface-ka oo dhan waxay ku shaqeeyaan saddexda luqadood, oo si buuxda u taageeraya qoraalka Carabiga ee midig-ilaa-bidix.

security.title: Xogtaadu adigaa iska leh
security.description: Amniga heer-safka (Row-Level Security) wuxuu hubinayaa in dugsi uusan waligiis arki karin ardayda, imtixaannada, ama warbixinaha dugsi kale.

register.title: Samee akoonkaaga
register.subtitle: Bilow falanqaynta natiijooyinka imtixaanka dugsigaaga daqiiqado gudahood.
register.checkEmailBody: Waxaan u dirnay iimaylkaaga xiriir xaqiijin ah. Guji si aad u hawlgaliso akoonkaaga.

forgotPassword.title: Dib u dejinta furahaaga sirta ah
forgotPassword.subtitle: Geli iimaylkaaga waxaanan kuu soo dirin doonaa xiriir dib-u-dejin.
forgotPassword.successBody: Haddii akoon uu jiro ciwaankaas, xiriir dib-u-dejinta furaha sirta ah ayaa ku soo socda.

resetPassword.title: Dooro furaha sirta ah ee cusub
resetPassword.subtitle: Geli furaha sirta ah ee cusub ee akoonkaaga.
resetPassword.successTitle: Furaha sirta ah waa la cusboonaysiiyay
resetPassword.successBody: Furahaaga sirta ah si guul leh ayaa loo bedelay.
resetPassword.invalidLinkTitle: Linkigan waa khaldan yahay ama wuu dhacay
resetPassword.invalidLinkBody: Linkiyada dib-u-dejinta furaha sirta ah hal mar ayay shaqeeyaan waxayna dhacaan 1 saac gudahood. Codso mid cusub si aad u sii wado.

errors.invalid_credentials: Iimaylka ama furaha sirta ah waa khalad.
errors.user_already_exists: Akoon iimaylkan leh ayaa horey u jiray.
errors.email_not_confirmed: Fadlan xaqiiji ciwaankaaga iimaylka ka hor intaadan gelin.
errors.weak_password: Furaha sirta ah ma buuxinayo shuruudaha.
errors.rate_limited: Isku day badan. Fadlan mar kale isku day wax yar ka dib.
errors.session_expired: Fadhigaagu waa dhacay. Fadlan codso xiriir dib-u-dejin cusub.
errors.account_suspended: Akoonkaaga waa la joojiyay ama waa la demiyay. La xiriir maamulahaaga si aad u hesho caawimaad.
errors.unexpected: Wax baa qaldamay. Fadlan mar kale isku day.

onboarding.title: Sameyso dugsigaaga
onboarding.subtitle: Noo sheeg macluumaadka dugsigaaga si aad u bilowdo. Waad bedeli kartaa mar dambe.

school.title: Dejinta dugsiga
school.subtitle: Maamul macluumaadka aasaasiga ah ee dugsigaaga.

exams.title: Imtixaannada
exams.subtitle: Soo geli natiijooyinka imtixaanka oo arag warbixinaha toos ah.
exams.empty: Wali ma jiraan imtixaanno. Soo geli faylkaaga ugu horeeya si aad u bilowdo.

upload.title: Soo geli natiijooyinka imtixaanka
upload.subtitle: Soo geli fayl Excel ama CSV ah. Waxaan hubin doonaa saf kasta ka hor inta aan wax la kaydin.
upload.maxMarkLabel: Buundada ugu badan ee maado kasta
upload.fileHint: Si otomaatig ah ayaan u helnaa safka cinwaannada xitaa haddii faylkaagu leeyahay cinwaan ama macluumaad xilliyeed sare ka yaal, waana fahamnaa tiirarka maado kasta ee CAT1/CAT2/Final/Total.
upload.previewSubtitle: Wali wax lama kaydin — dib u eeg safafka hoose.
upload.rowsWithErrors: {count, plural, one {# saf ayaa u baahan hagaajin} other {# saf ayaa u baahan hagaajin}} ka hor inta aad kaydin karin. Hagaaji faylkaaga oo mar kale soo geli.
upload.rowsOk: Dhammaan {count, plural, one {# safka} other {# safafka}} way fiican yihiin.

fileErrors.unreadable_file: Faylkaas ma akhrin karno. Hubi inuu yahay fayl sax ah oo .xlsx, .xls, ama .csv ah.
fileErrors.no_rows: Faylku ma laha wax saf xog ah.
fileErrors.ai_unavailable: Falanqaynta AI lama dejin server-kan, marka faylasha hadda lama farsameyn karo.
fileErrors.ai_analysis_failed: Ma aannu fahmin waxa ku jira faylkan. Hubi inuu ka kooban yahay magacyada ardayda iyo buundooyinka, kadibna mar kale isku day.
fileErrors.rows_omitted: Falanqayntu kuma soo laaban dhammaan ardaydaada — tani waxay dhici kartaa faylasha aad u waaweyn. Fadlan mar kale isku day, ama faylka u qaybi qaybo yaryar.

cellErrors.mark_above_max: Way ka badan tahay buundada ugu badan

errors.no_file: Fadlan dooro fayl aad soo gelinayso.
errors.invalid_file_type: Fadlan soo geli fayl .xlsx, .xls, ama .csv ah.
errors.file_too_large: Faylkaasi aad buu u weyn yahay (ugu badnaan 8MB).
errors.unexpected: Wax baa qaldamay markii la kaydinayay. Fadlan mar kale isku day.

report.aiSummaryPending: Soo koobid iyo talooyin uu qoro AI ayaa halkan ka muuqan doona marka isku xirka OpenAI la xiro.

report.emailReportError: Lama dirin — isku day mar kale
report.dataIntegrityNone: Buundo lama waayin — arday kasta wuxuu buundo u leeyahay maado kasta.
report.noTermData: Faylka imtixaankan ma lahayn tiirar gaar ah oo CAT1/CAT2/Final ah, sidaa darteed isbedel xilli-xilli ah lama heli karo — buundooyinka maadada oo kaliya ayaa la heli karaa.
